title: Velocity change direction
description: Essential: The answer must state that the satellite's speed decreases from perigee A to apogee B.

title: Acceleration at perigee
description: Essential: The final expression for acceleration at A must be correct: a_A = gR²/(R+h)².

title: Period ratio expression
description: Essential: The final ratio T1/T2 must be correctly expressed in terms of given variables ω, g, R, h.

title: Apply Kepler's second law
description: Important: The reasoning for part (1) should correctly invoke conservation of angular momentum or Kepler's second law.

title: Newton's law at Earth's surface
description: Important: The solution must use GM = gR² to eliminate the gravitational constant G.

title: Circular orbit radius
description: Important: For part (3), the radius L of the circular orbit must be derived from ω²L = GM/L².

title: Semi-major axis identification
description: Important: For the elliptical orbit, the semi-major axis must be correctly identified as (r_A + r_B)/2.

title: Apply Kepler's third law
description: Important: The ratio of periods must be derived using Kepler's third law relating T² to a³.

title: Confuse radius and distance
description: Pitfall: Using R instead of (R+h) for the distance from Earth's center at perigee A.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Stating speed increases from A to B, or confusing tangential/centripetal acceleration.
